args.title: Fix incorrect export filename date in evening timezones
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

Update formatExportFilename in src/exportUtils.ts to use local date components instead of toISOString() so that export filenames generated in evening timezones reflect the correct local date rather than tomorrow's UTC date.

args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

This issue is a question regarding how Ledgerline handles transaction amounts and currencies with zero minor units, explaining that exact integer minor units (bigint) are used as per ISO 4217. No code changes are required.
args.title: Clarify money handling and zero minor unit currencies in documentation

result: {"pull_request": "pr-76", "branch": "repomind/issue-4426", "state": "open"}

args.body:
label: question
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Ledgerline stores transaction amounts as exact integer minor units (using bigint in Postgres) and handles currencies with no minor units (such as JPY, KRW, CLP, ISK, VND, XAF, XOF) with 0 minor digits as per ISO 4217, avoiding floating-point rounding errors.
